```{shinylive-python}
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 600
from shiny import App, ui, render, reactive
import pandas as pd

# Placeholder data for comedians
comedians_data = {
    "Name": ["John Smith", "Jane Doe", "Bob Johnson", "Alice Williams", "Charlie Brown", "Diana Prince", "Frank Miller", "Grace Kelly"],
    "Probability": [0.85, 0.72, 0.91, 0.68, 0.79, 0.88, 0.75, 0.82]
}

# Placeholder data for footballers
footballers_data = {
    "Name": ["Mike Johnson", "Sarah Connor", "Tom Brady", "Emma Watson", "David Lee", "Lisa Park", "Nick Fury", "Olivia Green"],
    "Probability": [0.92, 0.78, 0.86, 0.71, 0.89, 0.83, 0.77, 0.94]
}

comedians_df = pd.DataFrame(comedians_data)
footballers_df = pd.DataFrame(footballers_data)

app_ui = ui.page_fluid(
    ui.h2("Select one comedian and one footballer", style="text-align: center; margin-bottom: 20px;"),
    ui.tags.div(
        ui.output_text("result"),
        style="text-align: center; font-size: 24px; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 30px; padding: 15px; background-color: #f0f0f0; border-radius: 5px;"
    ),
    ui.row(
        ui.column(6,
            ui.h4("Comedians", style="text-align: center;"),
            ui.output_ui("comedians_list")
        ),
        ui.column(6,
            ui.h4("Footballers", style="text-align: center;"),
            ui.output_ui("footballers_list")
        )
    ),
    style="padding: 20px;"
)

def server(input, output, session):
    selected_comedian = reactive.Value(None)
    selected_footballer = reactive.Value(None)
    
    @output
    @render.ui
    def comedians_list():
        header = ui.tags.thead(
            ui.tags.tr(
                ui.tags.th("Name", style="padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #ccc;"),
                ui.tags.th("Probability", style="padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #ccc;")
            )
        )
        
        rows = []
        for idx, row in comedians_df.iterrows():
            name = row["Name"]
            prob = row["Probability"]
            is_selected = selected_comedian() == name
            
            row_style = "cursor: pointer; "
            if is_selected:
                row_style += "background-color: #007bff; color: white;"
            else:
                row_style += "background-color: #f8f9fa;"
            
            name_escaped = name.replace("'", "\\'")
            rows.append(
                ui.tags.tr(
                    ui.tags.td(name, style="padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #ccc;"),
                    ui.tags.td(f"{prob:.2f}", style="padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #ccc;"),
                    **{"onclick": f"Shiny.setInputValue('comedian_click', '{name_escaped}', {{priority: 'event'}});"},
                    style=row_style
                )
            )
        
        table = ui.tags.table(
            header,
            ui.tags.tbody(*rows),
            style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; border: 1px solid #ccc;"
        )
        
        container = ui.tags.div(
            table,
            style="max-height: 400px; overflow-y: auto; border: 1px solid #ccc; padding: 10px; border-radius: 5px;"
        )
        return container
    
    @reactive.Effect
    @reactive.event(input.comedian_click)
    def _():
        if input.comedian_click() is not None:
            selected_comedian.set(input.comedian_click())
    
    @output
    @render.ui
    def footballers_list():
        header = ui.tags.thead(
            ui.tags.tr(
                ui.tags.th("Name", style="padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #ccc;"),
                ui.tags.th("Probability", style="padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #ccc;")
            )
        )
        
        rows = []
        for idx, row in footballers_df.iterrows():
            name = row["Name"]
            prob = row["Probability"]
            is_selected = selected_footballer() == name
            
            row_style = "cursor: pointer; "
            if is_selected:
                row_style += "background-color: #007bff; color: white;"
            else:
                row_style += "background-color: #f8f9fa;"
            
            name_escaped = name.replace("'", "\\'")
            rows.append(
                ui.tags.tr(
                    ui.tags.td(name, style="padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #ccc;"),
                    ui.tags.td(f"{prob:.2f}", style="padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #ccc;"),
                    **{"onclick": f"Shiny.setInputValue('footballer_click', '{name_escaped}', {{priority: 'event'}});"},
                    style=row_style
                )
            )
        
        table = ui.tags.table(
            header,
            ui.tags.tbody(*rows),
            style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; border: 1px solid #ccc;"
        )
        
        container = ui.tags.div(
            table,
            style="max-height: 400px; overflow-y: auto; border: 1px solid #ccc; padding: 10px; border-radius: 5px;"
        )
        return container
    
    @reactive.Effect
    @reactive.event(input.footballer_click)
    def _():
        if input.footballer_click() is not None:
            selected_footballer.set(input.footballer_click())
    
    @output
    @render.text
    def result():
        comedian = selected_comedian()
        footballer = selected_footballer()
        
        if comedian and footballer:
            comedian_prob = comedians_df[comedians_df["Name"] == comedian]["Probability"].values[0]
            footballer_prob = footballers_df[footballers_df["Name"] == footballer]["Probability"].values[0]
            product = comedian_prob * footballer_prob
            return f"Selected: {comedian} ({comedian_prob:.2f}) × {footballer} ({footballer_prob:.2f}) = {product:.4f}"
        elif comedian:
            return f"Selected comedian: {comedian}. Please select a footballer."
        elif footballer:
            return f"Selected footballer: {footballer}. Please select a comedian."
        else:
            return "Please select one comedian and one footballer."

app = App(app_ui, server)
```
